# Capability matrix

This matrix tracks native SDK support and the public React Native wrapper contract.

| Area                                                   | Android     | iOS           | React Native | Delivery | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------- | ------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Initialization                                         | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | One default library configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Multiple client instances                              | supported   | supported     | unsupported  | backlog  | The wrapper currently exposes global initialization.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| VOD playback                                           | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Fabric component with native controls.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Live and DVR playback                                  | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Native SDKs own polling, recovery, DVR, and live-to-VOD transitions.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| VOD commands                                           | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Play, pause, seek, volume, rate, mute, and unmute.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Live commands                                          | blocked     | blocked       | blocked      | phase-6  | Public live controllers are required in both native SDKs.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| VOD event parity                                       | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Both platforms emit ready, state, progress, errors, buffering, transport, volume, rate, and video-size events.                                                                                                                          |
| Live state metadata parity                             | supported   | partial       | partial      | current  | All public iOS state metadata is mapped; the iOS SDK still omits DVR and video-size values.                                                                                                                                             |
| DRM through native UI                                  | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Widevine on Android and FairPlay on iOS.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| VAST/IMA ads through native UI                         | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Server-driven native behavior.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Captions, quality, and audio through native UI         | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Programmatic selection remains outside the current JS contract.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Cast, AirPlay, PiP, and fullscreen                     | supported   | supported     | partial      | phase-7  | Native controls work; programmatic commands and events are not exposed.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Watermark                                              | unsupported | supported     | unsupported  | phase-6  | No equivalent shared public native API.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Custom icons and theme                                 | supported   | supported     | unsupported  | phase-6  | Not exposed as a programmatic React Native contract.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Resume position                                        | supported   | unsupported   | unsupported  | phase-6  | A shared public native API is required.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Basic video management API                             | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | List, get, play data, create, update, and delete.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Basic live stream management API                       | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | List, get, play data, lifecycle, create, update, and delete.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Collections API                                        | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | List, get, create, rename, and delete collections with optional preview images.                                                                                                                                                         |
| Video statistics, heatmap, resolution, and storage API | supported   | partial       | partial      | current  | Heatmap, statistics, and resolutions are shared. Heatmap play data and detailed storage size remain blocked by missing iOS SDK endpoints.                                                                                               |
| Live thumbnails and ingest status                      | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Ingest status and remote, local, listed, and deleted thumbnails are supported.                                                                                                                                                          |
| Video thumbnails and captions management               | supported   | supported     | unsupported  | phase-4  | Requires native mappers and stable public TypeScript models.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Encoding, storage, and AI operations                   | supported   | supported     | unsupported  | phase-4  | Destructive operations require explicit API semantics.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Basic upload                                           | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Pause/resume works on iOS (URLSessionTask); no-op on Android basic uploader. Does not survive process death on either platform.                                                                                                         |
| TUS resumable upload                                   | supported   | supported     | supported    | current  | Pause/resume/cancel work on both platforms. iOS TUS survives process death via background URLSession; Android TUS does not (no foreground service). continueUpload resumes on Android; iOS re-issues uploadVideo with the same videoId. |
| Camera live broadcaster                                | supported   | supported     | unsupported  | phase-5  | Planned as a Fabric component backed by native capture pipelines.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Cached Bunny image loading                             | supported   | supported     | partial      | phase-7  | The current hook converts images to data URIs and bypasses native caches.                                                                                                                                                               |
| Android TV                                             | supported   | platform-only | unsupported  | phase-7  | Product scope must decide whether the mobile package includes TV support.                                                                                                                                                               |
| Public native dependency distribution                  | blocked     | blocked       | blocked      | phase-0b | The final release step replaces local private SDK dependencies with public artifacts.                                                                                                                                                   |

## Status definitions

- **supported** — Available through a shared Android/iOS React Native contract.
- **partial** — Available with a reduced contract or platform differences.
- **unsupported** — Available in at least one native SDK but not exposed by the wrapper.
- **blocked** — A safe shared bridge requires additional public native SDK APIs.
- **platform-only** — Intentionally available on one applicable platform only.
